chunks: Abi (may Allah have mercy on him) from Sa’d ibn Abdillah from Muhammad ibn Isa al-Yaqteeni from ‘Amru ibn Ibrahim from Khalaf ibn Hamad from the one who mentioned it from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Whoever gives charity in the month of Ramadan, Allah will turn away from him seventy types of calamities.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for giving charity in Ramadan according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Transmitted through the reliable chain of Shaykh al-Saduq, this hadith emphasizes the unique efficacy of charity in Ramadan, where the veil between the divine and the created is thinned. The promise of protection from seventy distinct calamities reflects the Shia scholarly understanding of Ramadan as a month of heightened spiritual receptivity and divine mercy, where acts of worship yield multiplied rewards.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 19. Abi (rah) from Sa’d b. Abdillah from Muhammad b. Isa al-Yaqteeni from ’Amru b. Ibrahim from Khalaf b. Hamad from the one who mentioned it from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “
The Almighty Allah keeps seventy calamities away from one who gives Sadaqah in the month of Ramadan.”
